response.raw_text: {"overall_diagnosis":"The failures consistently stem from spreadsheet modeling and formula portability problems covered by the xlsx skill. Outputs contained incorrect country/value/reserve mappings, unit and year-selection mistakes, and widespread recalculation errors (#NAME?, #VALUE!, #N/A) under LibreOffice/Gnumeric verification. The current skill emphasizes zero formula errors but lacks concrete guidance for cross-engine-compatible formulas, robust exact-match lookups, bounded ranges, deterministic country/year joins, and post-recalculation QA checks that validate row alignment, unit consistency, and reserve-to-exposure/RaR calculations.","diagnosed_skills":[{"path":"xlsx/SKILL.md","confidence":"high","diagnosis":"The spreadsheet skill does not provide sufficient operational guidance for building financial models that remain correct after external recalculation in LibreOffice/Gnumeric. The agent used incompatible or fragile formulas and lookup patterns that produced #NAME?, #VALUE!, and #N/A errors, and also generated incorrect Step 2/3 outputs due to country/year misalignment, wrong reserve mappings, zeroed values, and confusion between reserve value and reserve volume datasets. The skill also lacks explicit validation procedures for preserving row alignment after filtering/deleting rows and for verifying that annualization, percentage scaling, and reserve-to-value conversions are applied correctly.","repair_instruction":"Expand the skill with a dedicated compatibility and QA section for spreadsheet-based financial modeling. Require use of broadly supported functions and syntax compatible with Excel, LibreOffice, and Gnumeric; document preferred alternatives when newer functions may fail. Require bounded ranges instead of whole-column references, exact-match lookups only (INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP with exact mode), deterministic lookup keys combining country and year when duplicates are possible, and explicit validation that copied or filtered tables preserve row alignment. Add mandatory recalculation/testing after workbook generation and require zero formula errors after external recalculation. Add finance-table integrity guidance covering separation of value vs volume units, correct year filtering, conversion of volume-only reserves into value using the specified benchmark price, exclusion of countries missing required total-reserve data, and verification of exposure/RaR formulas, annualization, and percentage scaling. Require final audit checks for nonzero outputs, plausible magnitudes, correct lookup hits, and sample end-to-end reconciliations from source sheets to final answer cells."}],"unselected_skills":[]}
